$schema_note: Registered second-brain sources for RSI evaluation. `path` is the tree RSI runs against; an instance repo may set it to an in-repo copy under brains/<id>/ produced by scripts/migrate_legacy.py and keep the external origin in `legacy_path` (read-only). Only allowlisted agent-facing files are ever mutated; raw/, wiki content, credentials, and tool wiring are excluded by the global denylist in src/brain_rsi/sources.py. Relative paths resolve against the project root.

sources.description: Sibling Seahare LLM wiki (Karpathy pattern). Primary RSI target.
notes: wiki/ and raw/ are content, never part of the mutable surface.
